name: interactive-audit-runner
title: Interactive Audit Runner
description: A simulated accessibility and schema verification runner displaying live diagnostic ticks.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Interactive Audit Runner Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
